name: qa-mission-control
description: AI-powered QA engineering platform — runs locally on Windows, macOS and Linux

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:env && npm run db:deploy -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
